g.text: ient-default is set.\n --compose-model-selection <json...> A whole saved model selection (source, connection, settings.reas
oningEffort) as JSON (or @file, or -): one cell for its model, at its effort. Alongside --compose-model. Repeat it to add several
selections for one model (e.g. at low and at high) — each distinct selection is its own cell.\n --with-client-default
Also launch an inherit cell that uses each client's pinned model, alongside --compose-model\n --save-targets
Attach the composed environments to the suite (append, capped at 10). Default is ephemeral.\n --compose-server <i
d-or-name...> Server(s) to pin on the composed stack. Snapshots them into a server group, so the run keeps testing these
servers even if the host's own server list changes later. Mutually exclusive with --compose-server-group.\n --compose-server-grou
p <id> Standalone server group to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-host-servers No longer s
upported: eval runs take their servers from a server group. Use --compose-server or --compose-server-group.\n --compose-skill <id
...> Project-shared skill IDs to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-secret <id...> Project
SECRET IDs the composed stack grants to its runs. Without one a composed stack carries no credential — list them with `mcpjam secr
ets list`.\n{\"error\":{\"code\":\"USAGE_ERROR\",\"message\":\"Invalid suite definition: model: Invalid input: expected string, re
